description: Never call a food or plant safe; an unlisted name only means the list has no entry. Two checks for dog and cat owners. (1) Pet food and treat recalls by brand or product, from the FDA's recalls list for animal and veterinary products, newest first, with the reason, the company and the FDA notice link. (2) What a curated list of common foods and plants (chocolate, grapes and raisins, xylitol, onions and garlic, macadamia nuts, alcohol, salt, lilies for cats, sago palm, azalea, oleander, tulips, daffodils and more) reports about toxicity to dogs and cats, in the source's own words with its page and the date it was read, plus the poison control phone numbers (fees may apply). Use when someone asks whether a pet food or treat was recalled, or whether something their dog or cat ate or might eat is listed as toxic. For an actual ingestion, tell the person to call their vet or an animal poison line now. Not veterinary advice. Not for human food (use check_food).
